title: 1000th IP Reference Standard launch
bodyHtml: During the 50th Scientific Body meeting of Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission, 1000th IP Reference Standard- Sitagliptin Impurity A is launched by the Members of Scientific Body on 28th September 2022. With this Milestone achievement Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission, Ghaziabad becomes the 3rd Pharmacopoeia Commission in the world to have more than 1000 Pharmacopoeial Reference Standards in it's Inventory.
